storyCards.headline: Free As A Bird: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Beatles's "Free As A Bird" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Anthology 1" (1995) — not the song's original release year.

Artist: The Beatles · Title: Free As A Bird · Album: Threetles, The - Meet The Threetles!.
